hero.intro: An evening of honour, heritage and celebration — where the Black community gathers to recognise the leaders, builders and dreamers who lift us all.

story.heading: Recognition our community has waited for
story.body:
Too often, the achievements of Black and African Canadians go uncelebrated. The Sankofa Royale Awards were created to change that — to recognise the people whose work quietly transforms neighbourhoods, businesses, congregations and classrooms across the Greater Toronto Area and beyond.

Each gala is also a fundraiser. Every seat and every table helps the Canadian and African Women Aid Program build a larger platform of support: food access, youth programs, newcomer services and empowerment initiatives for families who need them most.

pillars.title: Honour
pillars.text: We celebrate African and Caribbean community members whose contributions deserve a stage.

pillars.title: Represent
pillars.text: We answer a lack of representation by recognising excellence across every sector.

pillars.title: Give back
pillars.text: Proceeds support CAWAP's programs for women, youth, seniors and families.

story.quote: It is not taboo to go back and fetch what you forgot.

items.title: The Red Carpet
items.text: Guests arrive in style and walk a red carpet lined with cameras, music and applause.

items.title: African Fine Dining
items.text: A curated dinner celebrating the flavours of the continent, served on gold.

items.title: The Awards
items.text: Honourees take the stage to receive the Sankofa Royale Award before the whole community.

items.title: The Paparazzi Experience
items.text: Professional photographers capture every arrival, embrace and triumphant moment.

items.title: The Excellence Awards
items.text: The first Sankofa Royale stage lights up, honouring community builders in traditional splendour.

items.title: Be My Guest
items.text: Dozens of nominees across leadership, entrepreneurship, humanitarian service, education and media.

items.title: The Power of Us
items.text: Limousine arrivals, a full ceremony and a celebration of the past that inspires the future.

items.title: Your story
items.text: Nominations and tables for the next edition open soon. Be part of the next chapter.

categoriesTeaser.heading: Nineteen categories of excellence
categoriesTeaser.body: From community leadership and humanitarian service to entrepreneurship, education, the arts and public service — every category honours a different way of lifting others.

ticketsTeaser.heading: Choose your evening
ticketsTeaser.body: From a single seat at the celebration to a front-row Platinum VVIP table for ten, every ticket supports the community work of CAWAP.

invitation.heading: Take your seat at the table
invitation.body: Join community leaders, families, entrepreneurs and friends for an unforgettable evening of honour and celebration. Seats are limited and tables sell out early.
